input.answer: I wouldn't put money in yet, I'd ask you first. The page's top choice is an account at "פסגות" with the fund "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", and it says 10,000 ₪ today plus 500 ₪ a month for 10 years (70,000 ₪ in total) leaves about 86,492 ₪. My own bank, like most of the big banks, is further down with a red minus of 3,000 to 5,000 ₪.

stuck.why: It opens with S&P, MSCI and נאסד"ק, all English letters, and a black background. I'd normally leave right there. I only stayed because the task was S&P 500.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the four boxes with sliders
stuck.why: The numbers were already filled in (10,000, 500, 10 years, 7%). I didn't know whether I had to change them. I didn't touch the sliders.
70,000 was the first big number I saw. I had to stop and work out that it's what I put in and not what I end up with.

stuck.where: Screen 2, two lists side by side
stuck.why: The right side lists banks, the left side lists funds. It took me a while to see that I had to pick one from each, and I didn't know which side to read first.
Every bank except פסגות has a red minus, like ‎-5,021 for הפועלים and ‎-20,309. I didn't know whether that means I lose money or only get less than the top choice.

Bank list: לאומי ‎-3,096, הפועלים ‎-5,021 and so on
skimmed: Colored tags on every fund (צוברת, חשיפה לדולר, עסקת החלף, סן גם על שינוי המטבע)
The bar chart and colour legend at the top of screen 2 (דמי משמרת, עמלות קנייה ומכירה, מס)
The grey lines under the banks, 'לא בחישוב מחיר אחר לצעירים…'
The rest of the fund list on screen 3
skipped: Screens 5 to 10, because I stopped after screen 4
The English funds (iShares, Vanguard, IE00…, us-ivv)
The 'אינפלציה' button and the dollar rate line
unsure_meaning: מדד in the sense of 'השקעה במדד'
Percentages like '+0.37% · בשנה · שנה אחת' and '-0.31%' next to the funds
Red minus numbers like ‎-3,096 next to the banks
Whether 7% a year is promised or just a guess
not_found: Anything about deposits or safe saving, or a comparison with a bank deposit
A plain sentence on what happens if the market falls
Anything that says who runs the site or whether it's official
Where to type in my own amounts without sliders

findings.what: The page opens with English letters and stock indexes on a black background. Someone like me would leave on the first screen.
Red minus signs next to almost every bank, including the big ones like לאומי and הפועלים, scared me. I couldn't tell whether that's a loss or only 'less than the cheapest'.
findings.where: Screens 2–4, bank list on the right

findings.what: Too many colored tags and numbers on every line made me anxious, and I couldn't read them all.
findings.where: Screens 2–4, fund list on the left

findings.what: The first big number, 70,000, could be mistaken for the result.
The grey lines and the small grey writing are hard to read even enlarged.
findings.where: Screen 1 under the cards, and the grey lines under the banks

findings.what: Many terms I don't know (צוברת, עסקת החלף, דמי משמרת, קרן מחקה) and nothing that explains them
Sliders for entering the amounts
Long lists of funds with English names. I gave up after four screens.
I couldn't tell who runs the site or whether to trust it. It's only called 'מקור'.
